Class InternshipController

java.lang.Object
project.InternshipController
All Implemented Interfaces:
FilterOptions
public class InternshipController extends Object implements FilterOptions
Controller class to manage internships, including creation, filtering, visibility toggling, and retrieving internships for students or companies. Implements FilterOptions to allow filtering internships by various criteria.

    • getInternships

      public List<Internship> getInternships()
      Returns the list of all internships. This is used by the main system and different UIs that need to view or work with all internship listings.
      Returns:
      the list of internships

    • getEligibleInternshipsForStudent

      public List<Internship> getEligibleInternshipsForStudent(Student student)
      Returns internships that a given student is eligible to apply for. Filters internships based on approval status, visibility, student's major, application period, student's eligibility for the internship level, and available slots.
      Parameters:
      student - the student to check eligibility for
      Returns:
      list of eligible internships for the student

    • createInternship

      public Internship createInternship(CompanyRepresentative company_rep, String title, String description, String level, String preferredMajor, LocalDate openDate, LocalDate closeDate, int slots)
      Creates a new internship listing for a company representative.
      Parameters:
      company_rep - the company representative creating the internship
      title - title of the internship
      description - description of the internship
      level - level of internship (BASIC, INTERMEDIATE, ADVANCED)
      preferredMajor - preferred major required
      openDate - opening date of the internship application
      closeDate - closing date of the internship application
      slots - number of available slots (max 10)
      Returns:
      the created Internship object
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if slots > 10
      IllegalStateException - if the company already has 5 internships

    • filter

      public List<Internship> filter(String criteria, String value)
      Filters internships by a specified criteria and value. Uses the default FilterOptions.filter(List, String, String) method.
      Parameters:
      criteria - the field to filter by (status, level, companyName, etc.)
      value - the value to match
      Returns:
      list of internships matching the filter
